page.title: Computer use
page.intro: Agents that use a computer get their own display. Every screenshot, click and keystroke asks you first. Watch them here, and take over when you need to.
page.empty: No agent is using a display right now. One starts the first time you approve an agent's computer action.

setup.title: Set up computer use
setup.missing_bins: This server is missing {{list}}. Install them, or run PasaBot from the computer image (deploy/computer).
setup.unsupported: Computer use is not available on this operating system.
setup.off: Computer use is turned off on this server.
setup.practice: Practice display: a built-in test app, not a real desktop.
setup.windows_soon: Not available on Windows yet. Helpers cannot see or use the screen on a Windows PC; everything else works.

mac.title: Let an agent use this Mac
mac.warning: A Mac has no separate screen for helpers: a helper you allow here sees your whole screen and moves your own pointer and keyboard. Each action still asks you first. The permissions belong to PasaBot Screen Helper, not to PasaBot itself.
mac.perAgent: Computer use on this Mac is off for every agent until you turn it on for that one agent here, with your password.
mac.permissions: macOS will ask you to allow Screen Recording and Accessibility. macOS gives that permission to the program running PasaBot, so every agent's own command-line tools could then use your screen without asking you. Only allow it if you trust every agent on this server, and remove it in System Settings → Privacy & Security when you are done.

page.intro: Helpers that use a computer get their own screen. Every picture of the screen, click and keystroke asks you first. Watch them here, and take over when you need to.
page.empty: No helper is using a screen right now. One starts the first time you say yes to a helper's computer action.

setup.missing_bins: This computer is missing {{list}}. Install them, or ask whoever set up PasaBot to use its computer setup.
setup.off: Computer use is turned off in this PasaBot.

display.controlHint: Click the picture to click on the helper's screen.

ask.title: Let {{name}} use this computer?
ask.body: {{name}} would see your whole screen and move your own pointer and keyboard. Every click and keystroke still asks you first, and you can stop it any time by holding Esc for a second.

steps.title: Set up this computer for {{name}}
steps.stopped: You stopped control of this computer. It stays stopped until you turn it on again here.
steps.helperHint: It starts with the PasaBot app on this Mac. If this stays empty, open PasaBot.
steps.screenHint: Settings opens. Find PasaBot Screen Helper in the list and switch it on.
steps.accessHint: Settings opens. Find PasaBot Screen Helper in the list and switch it on.
steps.tryHint: Takes one picture of your screen and nothing else.
steps.tryDone: It works. This is what {{name}} would see.
steps.ready: {{name}} can now ask to use this computer. Each action shows you a card first.

live.title: {{name}} is using your computer
live.idle: {{name}} is not using the computer right now.
live.stopHint: Or hold Esc for a second.

preview.click: It will click the red ring.
preview.rightClick: It will right-click the red ring.
preview.move: It will move the pointer to the red ring.
preview.screenshot: It will take a picture of the screen.
preview.alt: Where it will act on the screen
preview.none: No picture of the screen yet.
preview.noCurrent: No current picture of the screen. Look at your screen before you say yes.

server.setupCard: {{name}} wants to use this computer. Set it up in the card below, or ignore it.
server.liveCard: {{name}} started using the computer. Watch it live here.

watch.title: Confirm it's you to see your screen
watch.body: This is your own Mac screen. Type your password to watch it and take over here.
watch.again: It has been a few minutes. Type your password again to keep controlling your screen.
